title: Research: certify all three-frame P112 repair exclusions
body:
## Summary

```diff
 Sharp sixteen-group P112 minimum with original PR3356 frames retained
- proved when at least eleven original frames remain
+ proved when at least ten original frames remain
```

All 286 three-frame-plus-tail repair domains have no cover by five even orthonormal groups. A fifteen-group partition must disturb at least four original frames. This closes PR3387's incomplete three-frame pilot domain. PR3370's unchanged sixteen-group witness attains the bound and retains its construction credit.

Package: `research/p112-three-frame-repair/`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19008669).

## Evidence

- Before: three-frame pilots included 133 budget-unknown, 61 unrun and 92 unproved negative reports. After: two separately implemented exact searches reject every case without exhaustion and agree on every complete group inventory. Their full per-case receipts and the written completeness proof are included.
- Primary active-group search visits 533,382 states; the separate explicit-coordinate/complement search visits 2,314,084. Six behavioral groups include all 384 four-port family/slot oracles, 65 geometric cover cases, the actual attaining witness, budget-exhaustion rejection and three optimized actual CLI mutants.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized CPython 3.15 checks, Ruff/formatting, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight and read-only Git-free committed-export replay pass. A private runtime copy handled a shared interpreter permission incident; shared interpreter modes were left untouched.
- Publication commit `790aa043a08c5b2d6c2608f038bbea1f686a467f`; scientific source commit `5565a046acdad8bc12840d9bbd270e2ab93dc022`. Source pins and exact reproduction are included. Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-three-frame-repair`.

Credit PR3356, Tekalign/PR3370, PR3387, Matarener/Mark/PR3335 and the retained E8/P112 lineage. PR3383's fixed-row-space tariff boundary is respected.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package.

The theorem retains ten specified original frames. Unrestricted fifteen-group attainment, arbitrary fitting matrices, physical source acquisition, frames, restoration, hosting, precision, all-size/compiler and supplier admission remain open. The full-plane tariff stays 224; no native saving, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. No deeper repair search, proof-kernel, human review or selected cold replay was run. Frozen predecessors and shared code are unchanged.
